owned: focused promotion and sync regression tests

acceptance_mapping.portable_layout: sync-dev-root derives command-runtimes, integration-runtimes, authority file, and defaults from PANTHEON_DEPLOY_ROOT; when it is absent an explicit live-config derives the deployment root, otherwise HOME/pantheon-ci-deploy is used. No /home/lupin literal remains in the script.
acceptance_mapping.coordination_safety: promotion records coordination_code_sync=preserved and performs no copy, deletion, chmod, or mirror operation in the shared status checkout; supervisor execution remains pinned to the validated immutable command-runtimes/<SHA> candidate.
acceptance_mapping.single_authority: the existing promote-supervisor-runtime lane remains the only live-config writer and supervisor replacement entry point; no fallback loader or parallel promotion mechanism was added.
acceptance_mapping.regression: focused tests cover portable deployment roots, immutable exact-SHA identity and ancestry, dirty/shared coordination preservation, replacement failure behavior, watchdog repoint, and cron auto-integrator repoint.
acceptance_mapping.post_merge_live_gate: After merge, the supervisor integration lane must promote the exact accepted dev SHA and append evidence of at least three successful live cycles with no dashboard missing-canonical-identity error before owner done finalization.

review_decision.note: Independent reviewer must validate the frozen PR head and this manifest before approval.
